scope: Independent synthetic material-point physics/numerics audit; no solver, calibration or production-material claim.

findings.issue: Array subclass map can return the original F; evaluate freezes caller geometry.
findings.resolution: Require ordinary Array.prototype on matrix and rows; reject before invoking array methods.
findings.regression: outer and row subclasses, evaluate and step refuse without caller mutation or freezing

findings.issue: Draft small-x coefficient lacked x and draft metadata retained ancestors.
findings.resolution: Owner corrected both before reviewed final commit; no additional source change for these.

independentOracle.method: Gauss-Legendre 8 point quadrature of analytic ODE transient, without production coefficient helpers; 1-unit time-ratio segments through 64 and exponentially negligible tail beyond 64.
independentOracle.gradient: 9 first-Piola components from Richardson energy differences h=1e-4 and 5e-5

limits: Only in-process issued frozen states; JSON clone/restore is intentionally refused.
dt/tau restricted to [1e-6,1e6]; 4096 steps; 1 MiB per state, not a persisted trajectory.
No mesh, element, solver, material calibration, plasticity or necking validation.
summaryJa: 独立積分・エネルギー勾配・参照基底変換は成功。入力配列の所有権逸脱を再現して修正した。
summaryEn: Independent integration, energy-gradient and reference-basis checks pass. Reproduced and fixed caller-array ownership violation.
